summary: Helix Energy Solutions Group, Inc. filed this 8-K to report the sale of its Shallow Water Abandonment business (Alliance) via its wholly-owned subsidiary, Helix Alliance Decom, LLC, to C-Dive, L.L.C. for $107.5 million in cash, subject to customary post-closing adjustments. Helix guaranteed seller obligations and provided restrictive covenants. The buyer obtained a representations and warranties insurance policy. The Alliance entities were released as guarantors under Helix's December 2023 indenture via a supplemental indenture. The transaction closed simultaneously with the agreement. Watch for any post-closing purchase price adjustments and the use of proceeds by Helix.
